arXiv:2608.28100v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) deliver near-ab-initio accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost, yet their promise for Metal-organic Frameworks (MOFs) remains largely unrealized as large unit cells make first-principles training data expensive to generate, fine-tuned models are scarce, and experimentally grounded benchmarks are scarcer still. arXiv:2608.28495v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantifying threading dislocations in semiconductor materials via electron channelling contrast imaging (ECCI) is heavily bottlenecked by slow manual analysis. 该文采用DFT+DMFT分析MnF2、MnTe和RuO2中交变磁性的电子起源，聚焦自旋能带劈裂与多体关联、轨道杂化的关系。MnF2中强局域Mn-3d关联导致电子局域化、带宽变窄并抑制自旋劈裂；MnTe则因强关联形成较大局域磁矩，同时Mn-3d与Te-5p杂化增强自旋劈裂，是更理想的交变磁平台。RuO2表现为局域磁矩消失的Pauli顺磁体，说明仅有候选对称性不足以保证稳健交变磁性。

item.description:

👤 Aaqib Ali, Aslam Faqeer Mohammad
Accurate prediction of punching shear capacity in reinforced concrete (RC) flat slabs remains a challenging task due to the complex interaction between material properties, reinforcement characteristics, and geometric parameters. Conventional design provisions, such as ACI 318 − 19, employ simplified empirical formulations that are easy to implement; however, they may exhibit considerable prediction uncertainty because of the highly non-linear nature of punching shear failure. Moreover, although machine learning (ML) models, such as eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), provide enhanced predictive accuracy, their black-box nature limits their direct adoption in practical structural design. arXiv:2509.20191v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Approximating solutions to partial differential equations (PDEs) is fundamental for the modeling of dynamical systems in science and engineering. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are a recent machine learning-based approach, for which many properties and limitations remain unknown. PINNs are widely accepted as less computationally efficient and accurate than traditional methods for solving PDEs, such as the finite element method. However, PINNs are commonly claimed to show promise in solving inverse problems and handling noisy or incomplete data. We compare the performance of PINNs in solving inverse problems with that of a traditional approach using the finite element method combined with a numerical optimizer. The models are te…

item.title: 面向含激波问题 PINN 的高斯空间加权损失构造
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Kheir-eddine Otmani, Abdelhalim Azzouz, Nourelhouda Groun, Esteban Ferrer
物理信息神经网络在处理激波时常因网络表示平滑和全局平均残差损失而低估局域高梯度区域。本文提出一种由残差跟踪的高斯加权策略，用少量可学习参数表示 PDE 残差损失的空间分布，无需重采样配置点或预设激波位置。高斯中心和宽度随训练中演化的残差更新，可跟踪静止和运动激波；在低黏 Burgers 方程和二维 Euler Riemann 问题中，相比标准 PINN 明显降低相对误差和密度最大绝对误差。

arXiv:2608.27552v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite significant progress in the study of higher-order topological insulators (HOTIs), the chiral C₄T-protected HOTI has remained elusive in electronic materials, where C₄T denotes the product of a four-fold rotation and time-reversal symmetry. Specifically, we construct a microscopic model that combines a three-dimensional topological insulator with a collinear d-wave altermagnet on a Lieb lattice. arXiv:2608.27645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric and antiferroelectric phases of LiTaO₃ compete under different electric boundary conditions. First-principles density-functional calculations show that the high-symmetry reference structure supports two relevant unstable Γ modes: a polar A₂ᵤ mode at 181i cm⁻¹ that condenses into the ferroelectric (FE) phase, and an antipolar A₂g mode at 103i cm⁻¹ that condenses into the antiferroelectric (AFE) phase.
